title: Anna's Family
text:
My name is Anna. I live with my family: my mother, my father, and my little brother. We live in a small house with a red door.

Every Sunday we cook dinner together. My father makes soup, and my mother bakes bread. After dinner, we play games and talk about our week.

questions.text: How many people does Anna live with?
What does Anna's father make on Sunday?
How does Anna's family feel about spending time together?
Why does the family cook together on Sundays?
options: They want to spend time together
They have a guest every day

vocabulary.definition: a group of people who are related to each other
with another person or other people
a food made from flour and water that is baked
the main meal of the day, eaten in the evening

paragraph_translations: Мене звати Анна. Я живу з родиною: мамою, татом і молодшим братом. Ми живемо в маленькому будинку з червоними дверима.
Щонеділі ми разом готуємо обід. Тато варить суп, а мама пече хліб. Після вечері ми граємо в ігри і розповідаємо про наш тиждень.
